title: IRMAA Bracket Calculator
description: Given a filing status, look-back-year AGI and tax-exempt interest, and Medicare enrollment details, computes MAGI, the IRMAA tier, the resulting Part B and Part D surcharges, the distance to the next threshold, and the effect of additional income under consideration.
